crossRefs.note: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away…

translations.web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
translations.bsb: Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
translations.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
translations.asv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
